title: Milestone 2 — Reactivegas on kelgroups
summary: S4 correspondence work is landed. The first production Haskell core slice is now commissioned: deposits, withdrawals, cashier transfers and donations can proceed without the unaccepted vote substrate. Kelgroups voting repairs, simulator final validation and S3 instrument recovery continue. No production coordinator, browser or CLI release is accepted yet.

stories.title: Receive reports without pressing Enter
stories.want: worker reports to reach the desk through durable records
stories.benefit: I do not become the message transport or accidentally approve machine text

tracking.note: Standing supervision obligation. Acknowledgement and terminal-restoration defects are retained as owned tooling gaps; no separate implementation ticket has been filed.

stories.summary: Durable local reporting remains the protocol, but supervision is not generally repaired. The quality owner reported two approval-keystroke incidents that changed an auditor’s active model; restoration and the audit’s interpretation of that interval must remain explicit. New owners were verified through both launch identity and the active session. Transport timeouts were reconciled against real acknowledgements rather than treated as missing workers. A replacement epic owner also missed a child handback while idle with unsent text; the desk preserved that text and delivered the actual artifact pointer, acknowledged at 06:26:48Z. Staffing changes do not substitute for an armed supervision loop.
stories.acceptance: Reports arrive without user keystrokes; pause/recovery detection is exercised against actual delivery, and existing acknowledgements are read before waiting for new ones.
stories.next: Verify the current prompt and resulting session state; consume completed handbacks before waiting, and distinguish a live command from useful progress. Never inject worker reports into the operator composer.

stories.acceptance: Keep cumulative spend and failed evidence; distinguish implementation, owner green, independent acceptance, landing and release in each report.
stories.next: Measure accepted outcomes and total reported author/owner/auditor cost, including rejected attempts, repair cycles and supervision interventions. Keep unknown telemetry unknown and unchanged parked tickets parked.
